headline: A 2011 executive order directs the federal government to take steps to reduce shortages of prescription drugs.
what_it_does: This executive order, signed by President Obama on October 31, 2011, tells federal agencies to work on reducing shortages of prescription drugs in the United States. No official summary was provided, so the specific steps the order requires are not described here.

who_it_affects.group: Patients who rely on prescription drugs
who_it_affects.how: The order aims to make it less likely that the medicines they need become hard to get.
They are directed to take action to address prescription drug shortages.
